title: SpaceHoloSwitch

# ✨ SpaceHoloSwitch — The Ultimate Hologram Bridge!
**SpaceHoloSwitch** is an innovative solution for automatic hologram synchronization. The plugin dynamically switches between **DecentHolograms** and **FancyHolograms** based on the player's client version, ensuring the best visual experience for everyone.

---

![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60d894938a3386d76b237b0fbfc931490433f9d9.png)

---

### 🚀 How to use?
1. Install the required dependencies: **FancyHolograms**, **DecentHolograms**, and **ViaVersion**.
2. Restart your server — the plugin will initialize automatically.
3. For versions **1.19.4 and above**, the plugin automatically hides DecentHolograms and displays modern FancyHolograms.
4. Customize your holograms using commands or settings from both systems.
5. Use `/spaceholo reload` to sync all changes instantly.

---

### 🔥 Feature List
* ✅ **Automatic Switching** — Seamless transition between hologram systems based on client version.
* ✅ **Full Text Editing** — Add, remove, or edit lines on the fly.
* ✅ **Rich Formatting** — Full support for **HEX**, **Legacy**, and **MiniMessage** (gradients/tags).
* ✅ **Precise Alignment** — Tools to keep holograms perfectly synced between systems.
* ✅ **Interactive List** — Paginated list of all active holograms with easy management.
* ✅ **Dynamic Control** — Set custom update intervals and move holograms via commands.

---

### 🛠 Command Reference
> **Main Command:** `/spaceholo`

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `create <name>` | Create a hologram in both systems |
| `remove <name>` | Delete a hologram from both systems |
| `edit <name> addline <text>` | Add a new line to a hologram |
| `movehere <name>` | Move a hologram to your current location |
| `align <name>` | Manually align holograms between systems |
| `list [page]` | Show a paginated list of all holograms |
| `reload` | Reload configuration and sync holograms |

---

### 📦 Dependencies & Permissions
**Dependencies:**
* **FancyHolograms**
* **DecentHolograms**
* **ViaVersion**

**Key Permissions:**
* `spaceholoswitch.command.spaceholo` (Access to main command)
* `spaceholoswitch.command.create` (Create holograms)
* `spaceholoswitch.command.edit` (Edit lines)
* `spaceholoswitch.command.reload` (Reload plugin)
